title: Forge hybrid build plan
decision: Hybrid A + B: A responsive shell and domain screens, B bento Today home (decision recorded 2026-11-12).

phases.name: Foundations and hotfix
phases.goal: Fix the live sync write bug, record the decisions, and build the hybrid design system, router, responsive shell, inspector and palette around the unchanged legacy tabs, with test and deploy plumbing.
exit: npm test and npm run build green
a failed kv_store upload now sets the sync-failed banner (unit test)
Playwright (Chromium) shows bottom tabs below 600px, a 72px rail at 600-1023px and a 220px sidebar from 1024px, with no horizontal scroll at 390/834/1194/1440
Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the palette; hover rules are guarded and focus-visible is global (css guard test passes)
legacy tabs still work inside the new shell
ADRs 0001-0004 merged

phases.name: Hybrid screens and Today home
phases.goal: Rebuild every screen on the new shell: bento Today home plus the Life, Logic, Money, Invest and Agents tabs as list/inspector screens, each with a single writer per data key.
exit: all 17 sub-views reachable at #/<tab>/<sub> and rendering in tab, rail and sidebar modes
Today grid shows 2, 4 and 6 columns by grid width
legacy Life, Expenses, Invest and Today implementations replaced; no two components save the same whole array (provider tests)
device-matrix Playwright specs pass
user completed the real iPhone/iPad device checklist (P1-U1)

phases.name: PWA, API hardening and CI
phases.goal: Make Forge installable and offline-capable, harden the serverless API, and put tests, bundle budget and E2E into CI with preview deploys.
exit: manifest with PNG icons passes install criteria; offline reload shows the shell and local data (E2E)
update prompt applies a new build without losing a typed task
api handlers have CORS allow-list, input limits, timeouts and a per-user rate limit with tests
CSP and security headers deployed; DSA page vendors supabase-js
CI green on a pull request with check + e2e jobs; bundle budget enforced
user verified install, offline and update on a real iPhone (R7-15)

phases.name: Sync v2
phases.goal: Replace whole-key last-write-wins with per-record sync (hybrid logical clock, tombstones, outbox, delta pull), rolled out key by key behind flags with backup and rollback.
exit: two-device simulation test passes (concurrent offline edits on different records both survive; delete beats stale edit)
v2_verify ok for every migrated key; SQL and backfill applied by the user
JSON export/import available in Settings
rollback to v1 per key proven in the cutover log

phases.name: Native app (Capacitor iOS/iPadOS)
phases.goal: Wrap the build as an iOS/iPadOS app with API base URL + CORS, native storage mirror for the auth token, platform adapter and Apple Pencil sketching.
exit: app runs in the iOS simulator and on a device against the production API (no relative /api fetch)
session survives relaunch via native storage mirror
Pencil sketch works on iPad
TestFlight build installed by the user

phases.name: Streaming AI, push and hardening
phases.goal: Streamed agent replies, reminder push notifications, keep-alive and bundle-secret scanning, and the final definition-of-done pass.
exit: agent replies stream incrementally and abort cleanly
a test push reaches an installed app
keep-alive prevents the Supabase free-tier pause; bundle secret scan in CI
docs/qa/definition-of-done.md passes on the deployed build
v1 blob mirror retired after the soak period

B3-01.why: Today data comes from per-domain selectors (R2-02/R2-15 life, R3-08 logic, R4-01 money, R4-12 invest) composed by B3-13; one owner per domain avoids a god-module.

B3-06.why: One router. Hash router chosen (no host rewrite needed, works unchanged inside Capacitor); API kept stable so path URLs remain a cheap switch.

B3-07.why: Same container-query shell; R1-06 is repo-specific (CSS partials, 100dvh + inner scroll pane).

B3-08.why: Same inspector primitive; the Sheet side variant moves into R1-08 writes.

B3-09.why: Same command palette; R1-05 gains the tested search index.

B3-14.why: Same App.jsx wiring; cream theme and Home tab folded into R1-09.

B3-15.why: R2 builds the Life screens and registry; routing uses useSubView + SubNav.

B3-17.why: R4 builds Money as MoneyApp; the legacy Expenses.jsx becomes a shim.

B3-19.why: Hover guard + focus-visible = R1-02; the CSS guard test = R1-13.

R1-03.why: Same token work; B3-02 carries the contrast-corrected cream values from the design spec.

R1-12.why: Sub-view routing adoption is done by each domain owner (R2-17, R3-02, R4-09, R4-19) to avoid four-way edits of the same tab files.

R2-16.why: All Today tiles live in src/today/tiles (one directory, one owner); domains supply selectors only.

R4-02.why: One set of chart primitives (src/ui); no second src/charts directory.

R4-10.why: Spend tile is built with the other Today tiles.

R4-20.why: Watch tile is built with the other Today tiles.

R4-11.why: R4-09 rewrites src/tabs/Expenses.jsx into a re-export shim, so no separate delete step is needed.

R4-21.why: R4-19 rewrites src/tabs/Invest.jsx into a re-export shim.

R5-17.why: Vendoring supabase-js for the DSA page replaces CDN + SRI.

X1-02.why: react-router-dom not adopted; hash router instead (also avoids the React 18 vs react-router 8 trap).

X1-03.why: R7-01 is the single writer of package.json for the infra dependencies.

X1-05.why: generateSW chosen over injectManifest; push handlers use workbox importScripts later.

X1-09.why: R5-03 provides the CORS allow-list (must include capacitor://localhost and the production origin).

X1-10.why: R5-01 already provides apiUrl/apiFetch with VITE_API_BASE.

B3-20.why: Habits as a B-style pet tile grid with rect-sorting drag. Default is A-style dense rows (R2-13); revisit once the user decides (open decision D3).

R6-01.note: URGENT live bug: cloud.write ignores supabase-js {error}, so failed uploads count as success. Runs first; the store.js serialisation dep was only about edit order.

R1-05.note: also owns the tested search index over screens, tasks and notes (from B3-09).

R1-06.note: 100dvh shell with an inner scroll pane (do not rely on position:fixed inside a container); rail 72px, sidebar 220px, inspector from 1024px.

R1-08.note: includes the Sheet side variant (from B3-08); inspector falls back to a Sheet below 1024px.

R1-09.note: tab id is Home, label Today (src/tabs/Today.jsx stays the Codeforces view until R3-02 renames it); mount legacy tabs unchanged; KEY_TO_TAB must allow one key to refresh several tabs; add the cream theme to the theme list.

R2-11.note: the Add-to-calendar link must go through apiUrl() so it works with VITE_API_BASE.

R2-17.note: Life sub-view routing via useSubView + SubNav.

R3-11.note: build fetchJson on top of apiFetch from R5-01.

R4-09.note: rewrite src/tabs/Expenses.jsx into a one-line re-export of MoneyApp (shim) instead of a separate delete task.

R4-19.note: rewrite src/tabs/Invest.jsx into a one-line re-export of InvestApp (shim).

B3-13.note: replaces the Home placeholder created by R1-09.

B3-18.title: Retrofit the Agents screen for the hybrid shell: wide chat plus agent-list pane, sub-view routing
B3-18.note: Logic, Money and Invest are retrofitted by R3-02, R4-09 and R4-19.

R5-02.title: Route the remaining /api call (Agents) through apiFetch and add a guard test against raw /api fetches
R5-02.acceptance: node --test test/noRawApi.test.js passes (fails if any src file fetches a relative /api path outside src/api); npm test and npm run build pass; with VITE_API_BASE=https://example.test the agent request goes to that host.
R5-02.note: all other call sites use apiFetch from P1 (R2-11, R3-11, R4-14), so only Agents remains.

X1-14.title: Add push and notificationclick handling via importScripts into the generated service worker, plus a client subscribe flow
X1-14.note: service worker is generateSW (R7-04), so custom handlers load through workbox importScripts instead of src/sw.js.

X1-07.note: BackupPanel exposes Export/Import buttons; mounted from the Settings sheet in R6-14. Must exist before R6-16.

R6-14.note: also mounts BackupPanel in the Settings sheet.

R7-01.note: single writer of package.json for infra dependencies; no router dependency (hash router).

R6-18.note: do not run before the soak period is confirmed (P5-U1); kv_store and the backup table are never deleted.

R1-02.note: also add @media (pointer: coarse) min-height 44px for buttons, rows and tab buttons (carried over from the dropped B3-19); R1-13 asserts it.

R1-13.note: also assert the 44px coarse-pointer rule and that every :hover rule is inside (hover: hover).

extra.title: USER: confirm or override the defaults in docs/plan/OPEN-DECISIONS.md
extra.acceptance: Every decision D1..D17 is marked confirmed or changed in docs/plan/OPEN-DECISIONS.md; changed ones are reflected by re-running plan-synthesize and plan-lint.

extra.title: USER: open the preview on your iPhone and iPad and complete the P1 device checklist
extra.acceptance: docs/qa/p1-device-check.md records, per device: bottom tabs / rail / sidebar as expected, FAB and tab bar clear the home indicator, no sticky hover after a tap, Today grid columns, no horizontal scroll, rotate keeps the selected item. Chromium cannot emulate safe-area insets or WebKit, so this is the only real-Safari check.

extra.title: Generate reminder .ics files in the client so native builds need no API
extra.acceptance: node --test test/lifeIcsClient.test.js passes (same output as api/_lib/ics.js for a fixture; a title containing %0D%0A cannot inject ICS properties); Add-to-calendar works with the network disabled.
extra.notes: toICS is pure in api/_lib/ics.js and can be imported from src (R5 report). A link to /api/ics cannot carry an Authorization header and would navigate the WKWebView away.

extra.title: USER: connect the repo to Vercel so every push gets a preview URL, and set the environment variables
extra.acceptance: A pushed branch shows a Vercel preview URL that loads the app and signs in; VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY and OWNER_USER_ID are set for Preview and Production; the log records whether Preview uses a separate Supabase project (decision D11). Needed before the P1 real-device check.

extra.title: USER: build and install the iOS app from a Mac (Xcode 26+): signing team, simulator run, device run, TestFlight upload
extra.acceptance: docs/qa/p4-native-check.md records: app launches on simulator and on an iPhone and iPad; sign-in survives force-quit; API calls reach the production host; Pencil sketch saves; a TestFlight build is installed. Requires an Apple Developer account (decision D13).

extra.title: USER: confirm sync v2 ran through a soak period without v2_verify failures or lost edits
extra.acceptance: The log states the soak length (default 4 weeks since R6-17), that v2_verify stayed ok for every key, and that you approve retiring the v1 blob mirror.

extra.title: USER: create CRON_SECRET and a VAPID keypair and set them in Vercel
extra.acceptance: The checklist records that CRON_SECRET, VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and VAPID_SUBJECT exist in Vercel Production (values never written to the repo).

openDecisions.question: Router: hash URLs (#/life/tasks) or path URLs (/life/tasks)?
openDecisions.default: Hash. No host rewrite, works unchanged in Capacitor. The router API stays stable so switching later is cheap.

openDecisions.question: Level/XP rule for the Today header: can Level ever go down?
openDecisions.default: Derived from wallet earnings plus completed tasks; never decreases.

openDecisions.question: Habits and Growth: A-style dense rows or B-style pet tiles?
openDecisions.default: A rows (R2-13). B tile grid (B3-20) is deferred.

openDecisions.question: Money: 4 sub-views (Overview+Txns merged into Spend) or keep 5?
Inspector pane starts at 1024px (your decision) or 1280px (blueprint table)?
Reminders: recurrence (Daily/Monthly) and a notes title field - in scope?
openDecisions.default: Out of scope for now; the model has neither.

openDecisions.question: Daily code goal and what "solved today" counts?
openDecisions.default: Goal 3, manual solves only (as today). Real Codeforces submissions can follow.

openDecisions.question: DSA map: iframe route with ?embed=1, or port to React?
openDecisions.default: Iframe at #/logic/dsa with a new-tab fallback.

openDecisions.question: Owner-gate /api/cf and /api/quote like /api/agent?
openDecisions.default: Yes - gate both; apiFetch already sends the token.

openDecisions.question: Production GROQ_MODEL (code default openai/gpt-oss-120b; README says a retired llama model)?
openDecisions.default: Keep the code default; fix .env.example and README.

openDecisions.question: Should Vercel Preview deploys use a separate Supabase project?
openDecisions.default: Yes, otherwise previews write real data.

openDecisions.question: PWA icon artwork: approve the generated flame on #0a0c10 or supply your own.
Your devices and iOS versions; do you have a Mac with Xcode 26+ and an Apple Developer account; Vercel plan and region.
openDecisions.default: Unknown - needed before P4. Without a Mac, P4 cannot be built.

openDecisions.question: What does "wallet" mean: habit currency, real spend, or both?
openDecisions.default: Habit currency (earnings from check-ins) in the header; money spend stays in Money.

openDecisions.question: Cream theme synced across devices (in settings) or per-device?
Sync v2 cutover: approve running the SQL and backfill on the live Supabase project, and who runs the keep-alive.
openDecisions.default: Approval required at the time; backup table first; per-key flags and rollback. Keep-alive via Vercel cron.

openDecisions.question: Where do Pencil drawings live?
openDecisions.default: A separate synced collection, never inside notes (IDEAS.md reasoning).
